name: ayo-food-delivery-backend
description: AYO Food Delivery — NestJS + MongoDB REST API
author: AYO Team

scripts.start:dev: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{const r=execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :3000').toString();const m=r.match(/LISTENING\s+(\d+)/);if(m)execSync('taskkill /F /PID '+m[1]);}catch(e){}" && nodemon --watch src --ext ts,json --exec "ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts"
scripts.kill-port: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{const r=execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :3000').toString();const m=r.match(/LISTENING\s+(\d+)/);if(m){execSync('taskkill /F /PID '+m[1]);console.log('Killed PID '+m[1]);}else{console.log('Port 3000 is free');}}catch(e){console.log('Port 3000 is free');}"
